items.text: Workload Management: Deploy, manage, and monitor cloud-based deep learning and LLM training workloads, ensuring high availability and optimal resource utilization.
Operations & Automation: Maintain daily cloud operations, write scripts to automate repetitive tasks, and manage infrastructure as code.
Resource Optimization: Monitor and optimize cloud resources (compute, storage, networking) for performance and cost-efficiency during heavy training cycles.
Security & Compliance: Implement cloud security best practices and ensure data and infrastructure compliance.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Collaborate closely with ML engineers, project managers, and cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality cloud solutions.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
Proven hands-on experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) services (e.g., Compute Engine, Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE), Cloud Storage).
Solid grasp of core cloud concepts including networking, virtualization, and containerization (Docker/Kubernetes).
Proficiency in Python scripting for automation and operational tasks (expert-level software engineering not required).
Excellent communication and collaboration skills in English.

description.text:
We are seeking a talented Cloud DevOps Engineer to join our team.
In this role, you will focus on daily operational tasks, automation scripting, and managing cloud infrastructure (GCP) specifically optimized for running deep learning and LLM training workloads.
If you are passionate about cloud operations and want to work at the intersection of DevOps and AI, we want to hear from you!
Responsibilities:
- Workload Management: Deploy, manage, and monitor cloud-based deep learning and LLM training workloads, ensuring high availability and optimal resource utilization.
- Operations & Automation: Maintain daily cloud operations, write scripts to automate repetitive tasks, and manage infrastructure as code.
- Resource Optimization: Monitor and optimize cloud resources (compute, storage, networking) for performance and cost-efficiency during heavy training cycles.
- Security & Compliance: Implement cloud security best practices and ensure data and infrastructure compliance.
- Cross-Functional Collaboration: Collaborate closely with ML engineers, project managers, and cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality cloud solutions.
Qualifications:
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
- Proven hands-on experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) services (e.g., Compute Engine, Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE), Cloud Storage).
- Solid grasp of core cloud concepts including networking, virtualization, and containerization (Docker/Kubernetes).
- Proficiency in Python scripting for automation and operational tasks (expert-level software engineering not required).
- Excellent communication and collaboration skills in English.

- Experience with Terraform for managing cloud infrastructure.
